disposition_reason: Reports Ni, total Cr and Pb (plus Fe, Cu, not tracked) by flame AAS in two anonymous chocolate products from Bwari market, Abuja, Nigeria; n=2 with no QA data and internally inconsistent dispersion and safety statements.

study.material_scope: retail chocolate, two brands, type unspecified
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Purchase market: Bwari market, Bwari Area Council, Abuja FCT, Nigeria. Cocoa origin not reported.
study.sampling_unit: one product of each of two brands
study.method: Flame AAS (Alpha 4) after microwave digestion of ~0.2 g with 2 mL HNO3:H2O2 (1:1), diluted to 10 mL with 0.2 M HNO3
study.qa: Standards and blanks described qualitatively; no recovery, CRM, LOD or replicate data.

findings.notes: Two anonymous chocolate brands (one product each) from Bwari market; chocolate type and cocoa content not stated (Pb discussion mentions "milk chocolate"). Mean of two products. No LOD, recovery, CRM or replicate count.
findings.integrity_issue: Reported dispersion 0.05 is neither the SD (0.099) nor half-range (0.07) of the two values; appears to be SD/2.

exposure_notes: Table 2 estimated daily intake (DIM = C x W/BW; child 0.02 kg/day, 20 kg; adult 0.1 kg/day, 70 kg), units labelled mg/kg (actually mg/kg bw/day).
